I untangled this by cross-checking against tee-sheet totals that three sources agree on (Champions 3474 back / 2614 front; Masters 3553 / 2529; Traditions 3202 / 2529). collection_notes:
ARITHMETIC: every tee on both courses was summed hole-by-hole and matches its published Out/In/Total exactly. Apache Links - Gold 3521+3542=7063; Blue 3351+3380=6731; White 3089+3195=6284; Black 2645+2549=5194; Red 2555+2454=5009. Comanche Lakes - Gold 3525+3475=7000; Blue 3317+3316=6633; White 3064+3079=6143; Black 2817+2780=5597; Red 2612+2504=5116. Par sums: both courses 36+36=72. All stroke-index rows verified to be a complete permutation of 1-18.

CROSS-VALIDATION: Apache Links and Comanche Lakes per-hole yardages were obtained independently from Greenskeeper.org and GolfPass and agree digit-for-digit on all 5 tees of both courses, so the yardage grids are high-confidence.

CONFLICT 1 - Apache Links stroke index. Greenskeeper and Hole19 both give men's SI front 16,12,4,6,10,18,8,14,2 / back 11,5,13,15,17,1,7,3,9 (evens on the front nine, odds on the back). GolfPass gives the mirror-image allocation (front 11,7,5,1,9,17,13,15,3 / back 10,6,18,14,16,2,12,4,8). Two sources beat one, so the Greenskeeper/Hole19 values are recorded. Same situation for the women's row (Greenskeeper front-evens/back-odds vs GolfPass front-odds/back-evens); Greenskeeper used. Worth re-checking against the printed card.

CONFLICT 2 - Comanche Lakes stroke index. Greenskeeper men's SI (5,7,15,17,3,9,13,11,1 / 16,14,2,12,18,4,6,10,8) differs from GolfPass's (5,11,15,17,3,13,9,7,1 / 18,8,2,14,12,6,4,10,16) on 11 of 18 holes. Greenskeeper was preferred because it is the designated primary source and it also publishes the women's row. Both rows are valid 1-18 permutations, so this cannot be resolved by internal checks.

CONFLICT 3 - Apache Links ratings. Two entirely different rating sets are in circulation. Set A (unlabeled by gender, from Greenskeeper and GolfPass's summary column): Gold 73.6/130, Blue 71.9/125, White 69.6/119, Black 68.0/116, Red 70.0/117. Set B (explicitly split M/W, from GolfPass's rating table, 18Birdies and a GolfLink search snippet): M 74.2/134, 72.7/131, 70.8/126, 66.0/119, 65.0/111 and W 81.3/145, 79.5/139, 77.0/134, 71.0/121, 70.0/118. Set B is recorded because (a) it carries explicit gender labels, which the schema requires, (b) three sources agree on it, and (c) it is internally coherent with yardage - the men's series drops 4.8 strokes across the 1,090-yard White-to-Black gap, whereas Set A drops only 1.6 there and even rates the shorter Red HIGHER than Black, which is impossible for a single gender. Set A appears to be a stale or gender-mixed column.

GENDER INFERENCE - Comanche Lakes ratings. Neither source labels the Comanche rating column by gender except that Greenskeeper names the fifth tee 'Red - Ladies'. Gold/Blue/White/Black were therefore recorded as MEN and Red as WOMEN. This is an inference, not a printed label. Supporting logic: 73.9/72.2/69.9 track the men's scale correctly for 7000/6633/6143 yards, while 70.3 from 5116 yards can only be a women's rating (a men's rating there would be ~65, and it cannot exceed the longer Black tee's 68.1). The Black tee's 68.1 from 5,597 yards is ~1 stroke higher than a men's rating would normally be, so that one entry is the least certain and should be re-verified. No women's ratings are published for Gold/Blue/White/Black on Comanche, and no men's rating for Red - those are omitted rather than derived.

MINOR DISCREPANCY - Comanche Black tee rating recorded as 68.1 (Greenskeeper); GolfPass prints 68.3. Slope 118 in both. Kept the primary source's value.

NOT USED - Hole19 lists an extra Apache Links tee at 4,743 yards (per-hole values sum correctly to 4,743) that appears on no other source and whose stroke-index row matches Greenskeeper's men's row. It is omitted rather than guessed at, since it cannot be mapped to any of the five named tee colours.

SCOPE NOTE - Glen Rose is roughly 60 miles SW of Fort Worth, at the outer edge of any DFW radius policy; include/exclude per the project's radius rule.

collection_notes:
HOLE COUNT: confirmed as 9. GolfPass and GolfLink both describe it as a 9-hole course, par 36, and publish a 9-HOLE course rating (34.1), which is only issued for nine-hole courses. 18Birdies presents it as 18 holes / 6,108 yds / par 72 because the nine is played twice from two tee sets - that is a presentation artifact, not a second nine.

ARITHMETIC: Red tee sums exactly - 285+125+365+306+274+130+238+396+277 = 2,396, matching the published Forward total of 2,396 (and 2 x 2,396 = 4,792, the published 18-hole figure). Par sums to 36. Stroke index is a valid set (all nine odd numbers 1-17, the standard allocation for a nine played twice, with evens falling on the second time round).

UNRESOLVED 38-YARD DISCREPANCY: the men's per-hole row sums to 3,016 (300+190+460+361+364+160+328+502+351), but GolfPass's tee summary and GolfLink both give the men's/back total as 3,054 - a 38-yard gap. I re-read the row against 18Birdies, which reproduces the identical nine numbers, so 3,016 is what is published hole-by-hole. Rather than adjust any hole, published_total is recorded as the verified sum 3,016 and the tee is named 'White/Blue' as the sources label the row. Two likely explanations for a human to check on the printed card: (a) the card has separate Blue (3,054) and White (3,016) rows that these aggregators collapsed into one, or (b) one hole was re-measured. The men's 34.1/117 rating, published against the 3,054 figure, is attached to this tee since it is the only men's tee described; if the card turns out to have a distinct 3,054 Blue tee, that rating belongs to it instead.

RATINGS: only one 9-hole rating pair is published - men 34.1/117. The forward/Red tee's 9-hole rating is published as 34.0 with NO slope; since a rating entry requires a slope, the Red tee's ratings array is left empty rather than fabricating a slope. For reference (not recorded, because they describe the 18-hole doubled round rather than the nine): White/Blue 6,108 yds men 68.6/117 and women 74.5/123.

PAR/HANDICAP GENDER: the card as published shows a single undifferentiated par row and a single handicap row, so both are recorded as 'unisex'. Note that hole 2 (190-yard par 3) carrying stroke index 1 is unusual; it is transcribed as published and not second-guessed.

No Greenskeeper.org page exists for this club (URL 404s and does not appear in search). No official club website was located; visitgranbury.com and a Facebook page are the only club-adjacent listings found, neither carrying a scorecard. No hole names are published.
